chunks: Said (Moses): "O Lord, I have control over none but myself and my brother; so distinguish between us and these, the wicked people."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Moses pray for in the Quran?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah At-Tahrim, Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) invokes divine separation from the corrupt court of Pharaoh, emphasizing that his authority was limited to himself and his brother Aaron. Shia scholars highlight this as a model of spiritual independence and distinctiveness from the corrupt elite, illustrating the principle of 'Tafreeq' (distinction) between the righteous and the wicked. This supplication underscores the importance of maintaining purity of faith amidst societal corruption.
